title: Rate Card Extract — Percentage of a Travel-Issue Service Fee Refund
content:
# Rate card extract — percentage applied to a travel-issue service-fee refund

**Rate rule.** The percentage of the travel-issue service-fee refund on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category depends on the stay: a stay booked with the host-only fee structure refunds at the host-only-fee guest service fee percentage of its policy; a split-fee stay of 28 nights or more refunds at the split-fee guest service fee percentage of the stay's policy; any other stay refunds at 14.20 percent.

Decision list, taken in this order on the stay's recorded fee structure, nights and policy:

1. Host-only fee structure refunds at 0.00% (the host-only-fee percentage of every policy, Flexible through Long-Term).
2. Split fee and 28 nights or more refunds at the split-fee percentage of the stay's policy: 12.00% on Long-Term; 14.20% on Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days and Super Strict 60 Days.
3. Anything else refunds at 14.20%.

## Applied to a travel-issue fee base of 2,000.00 (hypothetical)

| Stay | Percentage | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| split fee, 45 nights, Long-Term | 12.00% | 240.00 |
| split fee, 6 nights, Firm | 14.20% | 284.00 |
| host-only fee, 6 nights, Firm | 0.00% | 0.00 |
